purpose: Classify reusable Product exports without creating a second design-system package or repository.

families.label: Application
families.purpose: Generic product identity, navigation, action, communication, content and form composition.

families.label: Operations
families.purpose: Renderer-neutral data, status, telemetry, equipment, viewer and operational shell composition.

families.label: Workspace
families.purpose: Reusable authoring, editor, inspector, activity and document-workspace composition.

rules: Every public Product source module must match exactly one family.
Family is a discovery and ownership taxonomy; it is not a new package boundary.
Complete product screens, routes, transport policy, command execution and domain truth remain product-owned.
Robot control, navigation, spatial and safety semantics belong to the external Robotics package even when Product supplies a renderer-neutral composition.
